title: From the Binance archive to a tracked run
subtitle: Each stage takes one data structure in and hands one out. Click a stage for details.

steps.name: data.binance.vision
steps.role: Public S3 archive, one zip per symbol-month

steps.name: data/binance.py
steps.role: Fetches the archive and stamps when each bar became visible
details: Lists pairs, keeps 300 and fetches them in parallel

steps.name: data/store.py
steps.role: BarStore, append only, with an as-of read path
details: load(as_of) keeps the latest version visible at that instant

steps.name: panel.py
steps.role: split_relisted, then wide (T, N) float64 arrays

parallel.name: universe_mask
parallel.role: Trailing dollar volume, enough history, has a bar

parallel.name: features/spec.py
details: The causality audit fails the whole run if any feature peeks

steps.name: research.py
steps.role: Ridge per split, out-of-sample scores, dollar-neutral rank weights W (T, N)

steps.name: backtest/engine
details: Three kernels with identical results, reference, numpy and numba

steps.name: backtest/metrics
steps.role: Sharpe, IC, drawdown, turnover, cost drag

steps.name: tracker.py
steps.role: Records every run with its config, metadata, metrics and artifacts

outputs.name: qrp runs list | show | compare
outputs.role: Query past runs from the command line
